title: Container Bookings: empty release timing, equipment and prepayment settings by tier
content:
## Scope
This table covers the Container Bookings product line and gives, per tier, how early empty equipment may be released, whether the booked equipment type is guaranteed at the release depot, whether the line may substitute a 40HC for a short 40DV at no charge, and whether a cash-in-advance customer must have nothing due before empties are released.

## What each setting means
- **Earliest empty release**: the earliest release of empty equipment, in calendar days before ETD.
- **Equipment guaranteed**: whether the booked equipment type is guaranteed at the release depot.
- **Free 40HC substitution**: whether the line may substitute a 40HC for a booked 40DV at no charge when 40DV is short.
- **Prepayment before release**: whether a cash-in-advance customer must have zero charges due before empties are released.

## Tier table
| Tier | Earliest empty release (calendar days before ETD) | Equipment guaranteed | Free 40HC substitution | Prepayment before release |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 7 | no | no | yes |
| AHL Spot Flex | 7 | no | yes | yes |
| AHL Contract Booking | 10 | no | yes | no |
| AHL Contract Priority | 10 | yes | yes | no |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 10 | yes | yes | yes |
| AHL Premium Express | 12 | yes | yes | no |

## Points of judgement
**Which tier releases empties earliest?** AHL Premium Express, from 12 calendar days before ETD.

**Which tiers carry the prepayment setting?** AHL Spot Saver, AHL Spot Flex and AHL Guaranteed Loading.

**Which tier has neither guaranteed equipment nor free substitution?** AHL Spot Saver.
